subject: japanese
summary: Simple one-answer reading cards (6, 8, 11) are clean and the attached pages are always the right passage with no stray questions. The trouble is on the multi-item cards. Several show the question only as a small crop of the exam page that is unreadable at phone width (3, 5, 9, 10, 12), and their schemes flatten each row of options into a run-on heading and then give the answer as a bare label such as '(iv)' or a bare number. Internal authoring notes leak into the student-facing scheme ('Source discrepancy: scheme labels で as d...', 'Use the complete source website', 'no exclusive association is inferred'). The writing card (9) repeats the same full rubric seven times and runs to about five phone screens, and a 'half credit' language checkbox is repeated under every single item even where the answer is a number.

issues.title: Internal authoring notes shown to the student
issues.detail: Scheme notes written for the content author appear on the card. Card 12: 'Source discrepancy: scheme labels で as d, but the paper labels it b and has no d option. Preserve the answer text で and both literal labels' and the answer is headed 'd. で' although the question has no option d. Card 2: 'The paper says links 1–6, but the original website prints 1–10; the published answers include 7 and 8. Use the complete source website', plus a stray 'A: (23 marks)'. Card 1: a paragraph ending 'so no exclusive association is inferred... All other response slots remain independently assessable'. Card 3: 'The local spellings せんせい/先生 and ２年生/二年生 identify the same respective bank entries' repeated under three items.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove author notes from the card. Where the paper and scheme genuinely differ, state the answer in plain words ('で (option b on the paper)') with at most one short student-facing line.

issues.title: Question shown only as a tiny page crop on phones
issues.detail: Cards 3, 5, 9, 10 and 12 show the question as an image of the exam page scaled to about 330px wide. The Japanese text and furigana are a few pixels high, far smaller than the app's body text, and cannot be read without tapping Enlarge. There is no text version of the question on these cards. On desktop the same crops are readable but small.
issues.suggested_fix: Render the question as real text (rows of options as a list or tappable choices) and keep the crop as an optional 'see original' image; if a crop must stay, crop tightly to the item rows and let it scroll sideways at readable size.

issues.title: Option rows flattened and answers given as bare labels
issues.detail: Card 5: each scheme heading is the whole option row run together ('1. 金曜（よう）日 (i)げつようび (ii)すいようび (iii)もくようび (iv)きんようび · 1 mark') and the answer is just '(iv)', so the student has to map the label back to the reading. Card 12 repeats the flattened row twice per item. Card 2 and 10 show a bare number ('6', '3', '12') as the main text with the item name in small grey below. Card 7: the four multiple-choice options are run into one sentence in the question instead of the option buttons used in other subjects. The bottom summary bar reads '(iv) · (iii) · (iv) and 7 more' or '6 · 3 · 8 and 3 more'.
issues.suggested_fix: Show a compact answer table: item, correct option written out ('1. 金曜日 = きんようび (iv)'). Do not repeat the full option row in the scheme. Render card 7 as normal option buttons.

issues.title: Writing rubric repeated seven times
issues.detail: Card 9 (answer any 5 of 7 questions) prints the identical content bands and the identical long expression descriptors under every one of the seven prompts. The phone capture is five columns long and the desktop page runs past the capture limit. Band headings are duplicated ('1–1 marks · 1 mark:', '2–3 marks · 2-3 marks:') and the expression rule is printed twice, once plain and once bold.
issues.suggested_fix: Print the content and expression descriptors once at the top, then give each of the seven prompts a single compact row with a content score and an expression score. Fix the duplicated headings ('1 mark', '2-3 marks', '4-5 marks').

issues.title: Half-credit language checkbox repeated under every item
issues.detail: 'This answer is in Japanese · half credit' / 'This answer uses a language other than specified · half credit' appears under each point: six times on card 2, eight on card 10, five on card 12, twice on card 4, plus a bracketed '(Half marks if...)' line. For answers that are a number, a time or a circled option the rule cannot apply. Card 8's version says 'the inappropriate language'.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the language rule once per card as a note, with a single card-level toggle, and hide it for number, time and multiple-choice answers.

issues.title: Card 1: same slash-joined answer pool printed three times
issues.detail: The listening card repeats 'Maths teacher / famous foreigner / won maths Olympics / speaks lots of languages / speaks 12 languages / street performer / juggler / appears on TV (any 3, two marks each) popular (1 mark)' under 'Distinct response 1', 2 and 3, each with a redundant button and heading. It reads as a wall of slashes; the stem also ends with a stray '2. Peter Frankl'.
issues.suggested_fix: List the accepted details once as tick boxes ('any 3, 2 marks each'), with 'popular' as a separate 1-mark partial.

issues.title: Stray text and inline furigana in question text
issues.detail: Card 11: readings are inserted in brackets after each single kanji so the name becomes '照（てる）ノ（の）富（ふ）士（じ）' and '留 学（りゅうがく）' has a gap, which is hard to read. Card 2 has a stray 'Homepage 1' line; card 4 keeps the answer blanks '_______a.m. to _______ p.m.'; card 8 keeps the part label '(i)'.
issues.suggested_fix: Use ruby text for furigana (or group the reading after the whole word), and strip blanks, part labels and leftover headings.

issues.title: Attached passage not needed, or a duplicate, on some cards
issues.detail: Cards 5 and 12 are stand-alone kanji and particle exercises, but the attachment opens the reading passage of the same question (the footballer interview, the homestay flier), which does not help answer them. On cards 3 and 9 the attachment is the same page already shown as the question image. The generic label 'Original examination material' does not say what the student will get. No other questions are shown on any attached page.
issues.suggested_fix: Drop the attachment where the task does not depend on the passage or where it duplicates the question image; otherwise label it by content ('Menu', 'Okinawa leaflets').

Translation scheme broken into four natural clauses that read as a full sentence.
Short Japanese question with a single clear answer and the right leaflet attached.
